Use: compiled as C++ with -w (CMakeLists.txt) into ikv-client/audio-check; src/audio.cpp includes its header part
(STB_VORBIS_HEADER_ONLY) and decodes original Ogg beds in-process on Linux and Windows with every decoder allocation in a
fixed 2 MiB stb_vorbis_alloc arena. Previously vendored: nothings/stb 2c980bb (unpatched v1.22, sha256 4c7cb2ff...).
